Scatter plot of the restaurants distribution¶

In [202]:
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.scatter(data['Longitude'], data['Latitude'], alpha=0.5, c='red', label="Restaurants")
plt.xlabel("Longitude")
plt.ylabel("Latitude")
plt.title("Distribution of Restaurants")
plt.legend()
plt.grid()
plt.show()

Insights¶

In [ ]:
#From the top ten cities with thee restaurants having the best raings, these two cities, "Inner City and Mandaluyong City" are revealed to both belong to the top ten  
## with highest ratings and highest price range, which implies that cities with wider price range are more likely to get better ratings
